items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: He had Ahmad Jamal, Miles, he had everybody.

ctx.x: Well you know when I first started playing the guitar I was just 14 or 13, and a friend of mine who had a guitar laying around his house all the time, we used to just go around and

play around with the chords or something like that. But my grandfather was a guitar player in the church. So we played in all of the Gospel churches around the South. And I really never thought about playing the guitar, it was just something to do. When I got to be about 13-1/2, I started listening to records, to blues records and Gospel records, and I was playing with Gospel groups. So the Gospel groups, even though it was one group, they were playing in a different church every Sunday. And so by doing that I…

Now I want to ask you something about a guitar trio. That is, that really takes some kind of player, because you think of a trio you think of a keyboard player, because he can play chords with his left hand and he can solo with his right hand. So he can kind of comp behind himself. But with you just, what’d you have just bass and drums? That’s a lot of work.
